notes: 17 profiles. The seven panel slots were fixed in the pilot (profiles.json) and smoke-tested for connectivity; three extension readers and one unpriced candidate were added on 2026-09-25 (the pin date names the price snapshot, panel_version dates the extension); the third B reader was chosen offline from the 2026-09-24 router snapshot; on 2026-09-26 every sendable HF profile received route_context, the pinned route's context length in its router snapshot, as a per-route reader ceiling, and max_workers = 1 for the Llama-3.3-70B ovhcloud route

pilot_profiles.deviations_format: profile_id -> {changed field path: reason}; client.* paths are inside the client spec, user_message_suffix and answer_from_reasoning_field are panel-level; a test diffs every field against the pilot's profile file and allows exactly these paths

Aalt_gemini38flash_low.client.generation.temperature: temperature=1.0 is sent explicitly (the pilot left temperature unset); Google recommends keeping 1.0, and every generation default is recorded explicitly
Aalt_gemini38flash_low.client.capabilities.temperature: no longer declared false, so the explicit temperature=1.0 above can be sent

C2_qwen3_8b_hf_nscale_nothink.client.generation.max_output_tokens: 1024 -> 2048: room for leaked thinking so a failed enable_thinking=false shows up as reasoning_leak instead of finish_reason=length scored 0
C2_qwen3_8b_hf_nscale_nothink.user_message_suffix: none -> ' /no_think' (Qwen3 soft switch on the last user message): nscale does not forward chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking; connectivity smoke probe 2026-09-24: 104 -> 6 completion tokens, reasoning_content whitespace-only
C2_qwen3_8b_hf_nscale_nothink.answer_from_reasoning_field: none -> true: in the pilot nscale's vLLM returned the whole closed-book answer JSON in reasoning_content with a blank content in 44 of 102 B0 cells (one complete JSON object each, median 73 tokens; a system-line probe leaked 5 of 5), so a blank content with exactly one JSON object in reasoning_content is scored as the answer and flagged; the request is unchanged

C3_gptoss20b_hf_deepinfra_low.client.generation.max_output_tokens: 2048 -> 4096: gpt-oss reasoning cannot be disabled; the pilot's HIGH scenario (300 visible + 3000 reasoning) no longer hits the cap

plan_deviations.format: profile_id -> {setting: reason} for a profile outside the pilot whose settings depart from the planned panel

tierB_llama33_70b_hf_ovhcloud.hf_provider: the plan named HF deepinfra; the 2026-09-24 router snapshot has no deepinfra route for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, so the route is ovhcloud, the cheapest priced route with >= 64k context
tierB_llama33_70b_hf_ovhcloud.price: the plan quoted 0.10 / 0.32 $/1M (no source found); the snapshot price of the ovhcloud route is 0.74 / 0.74 $/1M, entered in the price book from the snapshot
tierB_llama33_70b_hf_ovhcloud.role: extension, not a panel slot: the pilot's panel keeps its seven slots; this is the third B reader the main run requires

field_notes.role: panel = the seven models of the pilot; control = GPT-6 reasoning=none + T=0 contrast; alternate = priced backups; extension = readers added on a route priced in the snapshot; candidate = no priced route in the 2026-09-24 HF router snapshot or no price-book entry, never sent and kept out of every run grid; negative = must be rejected by configuration
field_notes.access_tier: access tier (A | B | C3 | C2 | C1, bf16-weight hardware sub-tier of C); tier stays the governance tier A | B | C and slot the pilot's panel position, so the pilot's slots C1/C2/C3 are all access tier C1
field_notes.route_snapshot: HF profiles only: the router catalogue snapshot the pinned hf_provider route was checked against (tests/readers/test_panel.py: priced routes match the price book in, out and context; a candidate has no priced route there)
field_notes.route_context: sendable HF profiles only: context_length of the pinned route in route_snapshot (tests/readers/test_panel.py checks it against the snapshot). procedures.readers.cells records a cell as infeasible for the reader (reason route_context, not sent) when ceil(planned reference tokens x 1.03) + max_output_tokens exceeds it; the local access-tier ceiling (C: 32,768) is checked first and unchanged
field_notes.max_workers: client spec field: most requests of this profile in flight at once (procedures.readers.executor.run_cells never exceeds it). 4 everywhere except the Llama-3.3-70B ovhcloud route, 1 (four 96k-121k-token prefills sent together hit HF's 120 s gateway, 3 x HTTP 504; the same three sent one at a time answered in 34-49 s). Transport only: the client fingerprint excludes it, so request hashes and ledger identities do not depend on it
field_notes.thinking_soft_switch: true exactly when user_message_suffix carries the Qwen3 /no_think soft switch
field_notes.answer_from_reasoning_field: wire-level answer-field mapping, true exactly when thinking_soft_switch: an answered response whose content is blank while its reasoning_content, stripped, parses as exactly one JSON object is scored on that object and its row flagged answer_from_reasoning_field; anything else is scored on the content (E-parse when blank). Reader-side only: no request changes
field_notes.tokenizer_factor: provider tokens per o200k reference token used for HIGH estimates and spend-cap bounds; Sonnet 5 new tokenizer ~1.3 (verified in the pilot); others 1.0 (assumed)
field_notes.expected_reasoning_tokens: reasoning/thinking tokens per answer call in the pilot's LOW/HIGH cost scenarios
field_notes.reasoning_expected: false means any non-whitespace reasoning text or <think> block, or a reasoning token count > 0, is logged as reasoning_leak (mechanism check)
field_notes.user_message_suffix: optional; appended to the last user message (never a system message) before validation, hashing and sending; recorded in every ledger record and bound into the ledger header identity

A1_gpt6sol_reason_low.notes: OpenAI direct; reasoning_effort=low pinned; temperature/top_p/seed refused by capabilities

A1_gpt6sol_none_T0.notes: reasoning_effort=none is the only GPT-6 mode that accepts temperature=0

A2_sonnet5_nothink.notes: thinking disabled explicitly (default is adaptive); non-default temperature/top_p/top_k return HTTP 400

A2_sonnet5_adaptive_low.notes: reasoning variant of A2: adaptive thinking with output_config.effort=low

Aalt_gemini38flash_low.notes: thinking cannot be disabled (lowest level is low); temperature kept at the recommended 1.0; paid tier required; prices double from 2027-01-01; REST field name thinkingLevel to be confirmed by the connectivity smoke

B1_dsv41flash_direct_nothink.notes: DeepSeek direct alias deepseek-flash (no pinnable snapshot); thinking disabled explicitly; peak/off-peak prices

B1_dsv41flash_direct_think.notes: thinking enabled; temperature is silently ignored in thinking mode, so it is declared unsupported

B1_dsv41flash_hf_deepinfra.notes: HF router pinned to deepinfra; no thinking switch is sent (whether the route forwards one is unverified), so the connectivity smoke must confirm that no reasoning appears

B2_qwen3_235b_2507_hf_deepinfra.notes: non-thinking Instruct-2507; 262k context on deepinfra; fp8 label inferred from OpenRouter

C1_llama31_8b_hf_deepinfra.notes: continuity with the original manuscript (same weights, served at fp8 per OpenRouter label)

C2_qwen3_8b_hf_nscale_nothink.notes: enable_thinking=false is still sent via chat_template_kwargs, but nscale does not forward it (connectivity smoke 2026-09-24), so the /no_think soft switch rides on the last user message; the HIGH scenario still budgets 1000 leaked reasoning tokens

C3_gptoss20b_hf_deepinfra_low.notes: reasoning cannot be disabled; effort=low; MXFP4 native weights

tierC2_qwen3_32b_hf_nscale_nothink.notes: access tier C2 (workstation 48 GB, <= ~32B); HF nscale 0.08/0.25, ctx 40,960 (deepinfra 0.08/0.28 is the other priced route). Hybrid-thinking Qwen3 on nscale, so the Qwen3-8B treatment applies: enable_thinking=false is sent but not forwarded (connectivity smoke 2026-09-24), the /no_think soft switch rides on the last user message, output cap 2048. Timeout 300 s: the snapshot's ~42 tok/s puts a leaked 2,048-token answer at ~49 s after a 16k prefill. Not yet smoke-tested

tierC3_gptoss120b_hf_deepinfra_low.notes: access tier C3 (one 80 GB card; MXFP4 weights ~60-65 GB); HF deepinfra 0.037/0.17, ctx 131,072. Reasoning cannot be disabled: effort=low pinned, output cap 4096 as gpt-oss-20b. Timeout 300 s: 4,096 tokens at the snapshot's ~45 tok/s is ~91 s. Not yet smoke-tested

tierB_llama33_70b_hf_ovhcloud.notes: access tier B (bf16 checkpoint 70.6B params ~141 GB > 80 GB, multi-GPU); the third B reader. The only non-DeepSeek/Qwen model in the 2026-09-24 router snapshot whose published weights exceed 80 GB; its priced routes with >= 64k context are ovhcloud 0.74/0.74 and together 1.04/1.04 (ctx 131,072; scaleway 1.026/1.026 states no context, novita 0.135/0.40 has 12,288), so ovhcloud, cheapest at any input/output mix; structured output listed for the route. Not a hybrid-thinking or gpt-oss model: no thinking switch or reasoning effort to pin; same generation settings as C1 Llama-3.1-8B (T=0, seed 22, cap 1024). The catalogue does not state the served precision. Timeout 300 s: the snapshot's ~18 tok/s puts a 1,024-token answer at ~56 s after a long prefill. Connectivity smoke passed 2026-09-26 (served Meta-Llama-3_3-70B-Instruct, seed accepted). Long-context probe 2026-09-26: max_workers 1 (concurrent 100k-token prefills hit the HF gateway), route_context 131,072 (M0@full cells over it are not sent)

tierB_llama33_70b_hf_deepinfra.notes: the planned route of Llama-3.3-70B: the 2026-09-24 router snapshot has no deepinfra route (the planned 0.10/0.32 price is unverified), so it is never sent and stays out of every run grid. The model is on the panel through tierB_llama33_70b_hf_ovhcloud

NEGATIVE_hf_auto_routing.notes: automatic HF routing must be refused before any request is built
